documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum: terms supplementing an existing agreement for a provider's AI services, covering use of inputs and outputs.

terms.label: Agreement
terms.description: The existing agreement this addendum supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated 2026-01-15 between the parties.

terms.label: Training Data
terms.description: Customer data Provider may use to train models, e.g. de-identified Inputs and Outputs, or empty if training is not permitted.

terms.label: Training Purposes
terms.description: Purposes for which Training Data may be used, e.g. improving Provider's general-purpose models, or empty if training is not permitted.

terms.label: Training Restrictions
terms.description: Limits on any permitted training, e.g. Training Data must be de-identified and may not be shared with third parties, or empty for none.

terms.label: Improvement Restrictions
terms.description: Limits on Provider using Input, Output and Training Data to improve the AI System, e.g. only aggregated usage metrics may be used, or empty for none.

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) governing the use and disclosure of protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.

terms.label: Agreement
terms.description: The underlying agreement under which Provider delivers the Services, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated 2026-01-15 between the parties.

terms.label: BAA Effective Date
terms.description: Date the BAA starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Breach Notification Period
terms.description: Time within which Provider must report an impermissible use or disclosure of PHI, e.g. 30 days after discovery.

terms.label: Limitations
terms.description: Restrictions on Provider's handling of PHI, e.g. no offshoring of PHI outside the United States, no de-identification or aggregation, or empty for none.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) for selling and buying SaaS / cloud software subscriptions.

terms.label: Effective Date
terms.description: Date the framework terms start, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Order Date
terms.description: Date the Order Form starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Cloud Service
terms.description: The cloud product being subscribed to, e.g. Acme Analytics web platform, Pro plan for 50 users.

terms.label: Subscription Period
terms.description: Length of each subscription term, which renews automatically, e.g. 1 year from the Order Date.

terms.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
terms.description: Deadline to give notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period.

terms.label: Fees
terms.description: Amounts Customer pays and payment terms, e.g. USD 12,000 per year, invoiced annually in advance, due 30 days from invoice.

terms.label: Technical Support
terms.description: Support Provider gives during the Subscription Period, e.g. email support on business days, 9am to 5pm Pacific time.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.description: Maximum liability for most claims, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim (Common Paper default), or USD 100,000.

terms.label: Provider Covered Claims
terms.description: Third-party claims Provider must indemnify against, e.g. claims that the Product infringes or misappropriates a third party's intellectual property rights.

terms.label: Customer Covered Claims
terms.description: Third-party claims Customer must indemnify against, e.g. claims that Customer Content infringes a third party's rights or violates law, or empty for none.

terms.label: Governing Law
terms.description: US state whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware.

terms.label: Chosen Courts
terms.description: Courts with exclusive jurisdiction over disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware.

terms.label: DPA
terms.description: The data processing agreement between the parties, if any, e.g. Common Paper DPA dated 2026-01-15, or empty for none.

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement (DPA) setting out how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer (GDPR and similar privacy laws).

terms.label: Agreement
terms.description: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated 2026-01-15 between the parties.

terms.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
terms.description: What Provider does with the personal data and why, e.g. hosting and processing customer records to provide the Service.

terms.label: Duration of Processing
terms.description: How long processing lasts, e.g. for the term of the Agreement plus 30 days for deletion.

terms.label: Frequency of Transfer
terms.description: How often personal data is transferred, e.g. continuous for the term of the Agreement.

terms.label: Categories of Data Subjects
terms.description: Whose personal data is processed, e.g. Customer's employees, end users and customers.

terms.label: Categories of Personal Data
terms.description: Types of personal data processed, e.g. names, email addresses, IP addresses and usage data.

terms.label: Special Category Data
terms.description: Any GDPR Article 9 sensitive data processed, e.g. health data, or None.

terms.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
terms.description: Extra safeguards for special category data, e.g. encryption at rest and access limited to named personnel, or empty for none.

terms.label: Approved Subprocessors
terms.description: List of subprocessors with country and processing task, e.g. Amazon Web Services (USA, hosting); Stripe (USA, payments), or a URL to the list.

terms.label: Governing Member State
terms.description: EU member state whose law and courts govern the EEA SCCs, e.g. Ireland.

terms.label: Security Policy
terms.description: Security standards Provider is audited against, e.g. SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001.

terms.label: Provider Security Contact
terms.description: Contact for security requests and questionnaires, e.g. security@provider.com.

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement giving an early partner access to a product in exchange for feedback.

terms.label: Effective Date
terms.description: Date the agreement starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Product
terms.description: The product or services Partner gets early access to, e.g. Acme Analytics beta web application.

terms.label: Program
terms.description: What the design partner program involves, e.g. monthly feedback calls and testing new features before release.

terms.label: Term
terms.description: How long the agreement lasts, e.g. 6 months from the Effective Date.

terms.label: Fees
terms.description: Amounts Partner pays Provider, e.g. USD 500 per month, or None.

terms.label: Governing Law
terms.description: US state whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware.

terms.label: Chosen Courts
terms.description: Courts with exclusive jurisdiction over disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper Mutual NDA (MNDA) for protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties: a cover page with the business terms followed by the standard terms.

terms.label: Purpose
terms.description: How Confidential Information may be used, e.g. Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

terms.label: Effective Date
terms.description: Date the MNDA starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: MNDA Term
terms.description: Exactly expires (the MNDA expires mndaTermYears after the Effective Date) or untilTerminated (continues until terminated).

terms.label: MNDA Term Years
terms.description: Whole number of years before the MNDA expires, e.g. 1. Only used when mndaTerm is expires.

terms.label: Term of Confidentiality
terms.description: Exactly years (confidentiality lasts confidentialityYears after the Effective Date) or perpetual.

terms.label: Confidentiality Years
terms.description: Whole number of years confidentiality lasts, e.g. 1. Only used when confidentialityTerm is years.

terms.label: Governing Law
terms.description: US state whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware.

terms.label: Jurisdiction
terms.description: City or county and state of the courts, e.g. courts located in New Castle, DE.

terms.label: MNDA Modifications
terms.description: Modifications to the standard terms, or empty for none.

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for business partnerships where each party performs agreed obligations, including joint marketing.

terms.label: Effective Date
terms.description: Date the agreement starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: End Date
terms.description: Date the agreement ends, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Obligations
terms.description: What each party must do, e.g. Company lists Partner in its integrations directory; Partner co-hosts two webinars per quarter.

terms.label: Territory
terms.description: Where each party may use the other's Brand Elements, e.g. United States and Canada, or worldwide.

terms.label: Brand Guidelines
terms.description: Rules for using each party's trademarks and logos, e.g. a URL to each party's brand guidelines, or empty for none.

terms.label: Fees
terms.description: Amounts one party owes the other and currency, e.g. Partner pays Company 20% of net revenue from referred customers, or None.

terms.label: Payment Process
terms.description: How Fees are billed, e.g. the receiving party invoices monthly in arrears.

terms.label: Payment Schedule
terms.description: When Fees must be paid, e.g. within 30 days of the invoice date.

terms.label: Additional Warranties
terms.description: Extra promises each party makes beyond the standard warranties, e.g. each party maintains SOC 2 Type II certification, or empty for none.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.description: Maximum liability for most claims, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim (Common Paper default), or USD 100,000.

terms.label: Increased Claims
terms.description: Claims subject to the higher Increased Cap Amount, e.g. breach of data protection obligations, or empty for none.

terms.label: Increased Cap Amount
terms.description: Maximum liability for Increased Claims, e.g. 3 times the General Cap Amount, or USD 500,000.

terms.label: Unlimited Claims
terms.description: Claims with no liability cap, e.g. indemnification obligations and breach of confidentiality, or empty for none.

terms.label: Company Covered Claims
terms.description: Third-party claims Company must indemnify against, e.g. claims that Company's Brand Elements infringe a third party's intellectual property rights.

terms.label: Partner Covered Claims
terms.description: Third-party claims Partner must indemnify against, e.g. claims that Partner's Brand Elements infringe a third party's intellectual property rights.

terms.label: Governing Law
terms.description: US state whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware.

terms.label: Chosen Courts
terms.description: Courts with exclusive jurisdiction over disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for letting a customer evaluate a product for a limited pilot period.

terms.label: Effective Date
terms.description: Date the pilot agreement starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Product
terms.description: The product Customer evaluates, e.g. Acme Analytics web platform, Enterprise edition.

terms.label: Pilot Period
terms.description: How long Customer may evaluate the Product, e.g. 90 days from the Effective Date.

terms.label: Fees
terms.description: Amounts Customer pays for the pilot, e.g. USD 5,000 due at signing, or None for a free pilot.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.description: Maximum liability for all claims, e.g. USD 10,000, or the fees paid under the agreement.

terms.label: Governing Law
terms.description: US state whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware.

terms.label: Chosen Courts
terms.description: Courts with exclusive jurisdiction over disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for services delivered under statements of work (SOWs).

terms.label: Effective Date
terms.description: Date the agreement starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Deliverables
terms.description: Services and work product Provider delivers under the SOW, e.g. design and build of a marketing website with 10 pages.

terms.label: SOW Term
terms.description: Period during which the SOW services are performed, e.g. 2026-11-01 to 2027-04-30.

terms.label: Fees
terms.description: Amounts Customer pays for the services, e.g. USD 150 per hour, or a fixed fee of USD 40,000 invoiced monthly.

terms.label: Payment Period
terms.description: Time Customer has to pay each invoice, e.g. 30 days from the invoice date.

terms.label: Rejection Period
terms.description: Time Customer has to reject a Deliverable before it is deemed accepted, e.g. 10 business days after delivery.

terms.label: Resubmission Period
terms.description: Time Provider has to correct and resubmit a rejected Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days after rejection.

terms.label: Time of Assignment
terms.description: When ownership of Deliverables passes to Customer, e.g. upon payment of the related Fees, or upon delivery.

terms.label: Customer Obligations
terms.description: What Customer must provide, e.g. timely access to staff, systems and content, or empty for none.

terms.label: Insurance Minimums
terms.description: Required insurance coverage, e.g. USD 1,000,000 general liability and USD 2,000,000 professional liability, or empty for none.

terms.label: Additional Warranties
terms.description: Extra promises beyond the standard warranties, e.g. Provider staff pass background checks, or empty for none.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.description: Maximum liability for most claims, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim (Common Paper default), or USD 100,000.

terms.label: Increased Claims
terms.description: Claims subject to the higher Increased Cap Amount, e.g. breach of data protection or security obligations, or empty for none.

terms.label: Increased Cap Amount
terms.description: Maximum liability for Increased Claims, e.g. 3 times the General Cap Amount, or USD 500,000.

terms.label: Unlimited Claims
terms.description: Claims with no liability cap, e.g. indemnification obligations and breach of confidentiality, or empty for none.

terms.label: Provider Covered Claims
terms.description: Third-party claims Provider must indemnify against, e.g. claims that the Deliverables infringe a third party's intellectual property rights.

terms.label: Customer Covered Claims
terms.description: Third-party claims Customer must indemnify against, e.g. claims that materials Customer provides infringe a third party's rights, or empty for none.

terms.label: Governing Law
terms.description: US state whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware.

terms.label: Chosen Courts
terms.description: Courts with exclusive jurisdiction over disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining target uptime, support response times and service credits for a cloud service.

terms.label: Subscription Period
terms.description: Subscription term of the related Order Form the SLA applies to, e.g. 1 year from 2026-11-01.

terms.label: Target Uptime
terms.description: Monthly availability Provider aims for, e.g. 99.9%, or empty for none.

terms.label: Uptime Credit
terms.description: Credit when availability falls below Target Uptime, e.g. 10% of the monthly Cloud Service Fees.

terms.label: Scheduled Downtime
terms.description: Planned maintenance excluded from uptime, e.g. up to 4 hours per month, announced 48 hours in advance.

terms.label: Target Response Time
terms.description: Time within which Provider acknowledges support requests, e.g. 4 business hours, or empty for none.

terms.label: Response Time Credit
terms.description: Credit when a support request is not acknowledged in time, e.g. 5% of the monthly Cloud Service Fees per missed response.

terms.label: Support Channel
terms.description: Where Customer submits support requests, e.g. support@provider.com or the in-app help desk.

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing software that the customer installs and runs itself.

terms.label: Effective Date
terms.description: Date the framework terms start, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Order Date
terms.description: Date the Order Form starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

terms.label: Software
terms.description: The software being licensed, e.g. Acme Data Engine version 5, on-premises edition.

terms.label: Permitted Uses
terms.description: What Customer may use the Software for, e.g. internal business purposes only.

terms.label: License Limits
terms.description: Usage limits on the license, e.g. up to 100 named users on 5 servers.

terms.label: Subscription Period
terms.description: Length of each license term, which renews automatically, e.g. 1 year from the Order Date.

terms.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
terms.description: Deadline to give notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period.

terms.label: Fees
terms.description: Amounts Customer pays for the license and support, e.g. USD 25,000 per year.

terms.label: Payment Process
terms.description: How Fees are paid, e.g. invoiced annually in advance and due within 30 days, or automatic credit card payment.

terms.label: Warranty Period
terms.description: How long the Software is warranted to conform to its Documentation, e.g. 90 days after delivery.

terms.label: Deletion Procedure
terms.description: How Customer removes the Software at termination, e.g. uninstall all copies within 30 days and certify deletion in writing.

terms.label: Additional Warranties
terms.description: Extra promises beyond the standard warranties, e.g. the Software contains no open source under copyleft licenses, or empty for none.

terms.label: General Cap Amount
terms.description: Maximum liability for most claims, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim (Common Paper default), or USD 100,000.

terms.label: Increased Claims
terms.description: Claims subject to the higher Increased Cap Amount, e.g. breach of data protection obligations, or empty for none.

terms.label: Increased Cap Amount
terms.description: Maximum liability for Increased Claims, e.g. 3 times the General Cap Amount, or USD 500,000.

terms.label: Unlimited Claims
terms.description: Claims with no liability cap, e.g. indemnification obligations and breach of confidentiality, or empty for none.

terms.label: Provider Covered Claims
terms.description: Third-party claims Provider must indemnify against, e.g. claims that the Software infringes a third party's intellectual property rights.

terms.label: Customer Covered Claims
terms.description: Third-party claims Customer must indemnify against, e.g. claims arising from Customer's use of the Software in violation of law, or empty for none.

terms.label: Governing Law
terms.description: US state whose laws govern, e.g. Delaware.

terms.label: Chosen Courts
terms.description: Courts with exclusive jurisdiction over disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle County, Delaware.
